decision_schedule: Each complete UTC 15m bar close + 1ms; next full minute fill via literal ceil; fixed timing scenario.
price_scenario: Last completed 1m mark close; fallback unavailable rejects. Not historical mark-at-scan or bid/ask.
spread_semantics: DECISION_QUOTE_ONLY_GRID: synthetic decision bid/ask = causal reference*(1 +/- spread_bps/20000). Source simulator uses unmodified last-trade 1m bars for fills/exits and its literal 3bps modeled market entry/stop slippage. V2 resting-limit fill has no market entry slippage. No historical fill bid/ask is inferred and no extra spread cash fee is added. This preserves source semantics; grid is sensitivity to decision geometry, not total round-trip spread costs.
engineering_revision: Pre-analysis correction: discard initial research partitions that incorrectly used entry-side spread for exits. Revised spread definition frozen before any broad performance aggregation. No strategy parameter changed.
cap_definition: Prior analysis cost-inclusive 2R target applied AFTER original-objective decision/fill >=2 costRR screen; BUY floor((2*loss + E + E*entryFee)/(1-exitFee)); SELL ceil((E-E*entryFee-2*loss)/(1+exitFee)). Funding separate.
equal_risk: Actual source downward lots/notional caps retained; arms limited to hypothetical control planned cash risk. Also report fixed .5*netR separately; never confuse capped cash with normalized cash.
v2_execution: Import executor.createPendingOrder and stepPaperTrade directly, shim candle fetch to completed local executable scenario bars and virtual minute clock; preserve native unrounded TP, raw-risk sizing, maker/taker fees, stop-first and source gap/expiry behavior. Source V2 omits funding; V2_FUNDING_SENSITIVITY adds frozen V3 funding model separately.
source_tests: v33/v34/v34b/captureHardening; source Git-history fingerprint test separately replaced by audit SHA checks on snapshot.
